name: @pipeworx/mcp-intact

tools.name: find_interactions
tools.description: IntAct (EBI) molecular-interaction database — find protein-protein and other molecular interactions for a gene/protein (by name or UniProt id), with detection method, interaction type, organism, PubMed ref, and MI confidence score. Keyless.

query.description: Gene name, protein name, or UniProt accession (e.g. "EGFR_HUMAN", "BRCA2", "P04637").

tools.name: interaction_count
tools.description: IntAct (EBI) — fast count of how many molecular interactions a gene/protein (by name or UniProt id) has. Keyless.

query.description: Gene name, protein name, or UniProt accession (e.g. "EGFR_HUMAN", "BRCA2", "P04637").

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-intact forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the intact pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
